title.narrative: “Taking My Place”: Breaking Gender Stereotypes, Teaching Young Fathers to Embrace Their Role in Children’s Early Learning

description.narrative: Programme: The training workshops will be led by various facilitators, including educators, life coaches, and creatives versed in technology use in early learning. Young fathers will be engaged in topics inclusive of: 1. Breaking the Cycle: learning how to become more involved in children's early learning 2. Making Learning Fun: safe use of technology in teaching and learning at home 3. Overcoming Stereotypical Roles: understanding typical male and female roles transformation/evolution 4. Conquering Barriers: overcoming challenges and obstacles towards more active participation 5. Child Development: learning about what is appropriate, inappropriate, and overall child development and behaviors 6. “Give Mommy a Break": learning simple ways to engage young children independently Proposed roundtables: 1. Young fathers in three rural areas will be equipped with the necessary skills through various training to foster involvement in children’s early learning experiences 2. A training model: which can be utilized with young fathers in other parts of rural Trinidad
